name: kiro-chat
description: Chat with the Kiro agent inside VS Code, like Copilot Chat.

Kiro Chat: Add to Chat Context
Kiro Chat: Move Panel (sidebar, bottom or right)
Kiro Chat: Edit Local Memory (not committed)

kiroChat.allowFileWrites.markdownDescription: Let Kiro keep the files it edits. Turning this off does **not** stop the write: Kiro CLI performs its own edits, so the extension snapshots each file before the turn and restores it at the end. The file changes on disk briefly in between, where a file watcher or build could see it.

kiroChat.args.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for `kiro-cli acp`, for example `["--agent", "my-agent"]` to start with a saved agent config — which is where a `resources` list of memory files lives. Added **after** `acp`, since that is where its options belong: `kiro-cli --agent x acp` is rejected outright.

kiroChat.askBeforeEdits.markdownDescription: Ask permission before each edit **as well as** showing the diff afterwards. Off by default, because the diff asks the same question at the point where there is something to look at. Turn it on when stopping a write matters more than reviewing one: Kiro CLI writes files itself, so the diff can only put a file back, while this prompt is the one gate that can stop a write reaching disk at all.

kiroChat.attachActiveFile.description: Send the file you are looking at with each message, so Kiro can open it. It shows as a chip above the message box; click the chip to leave it out of one message.

kiroChat.autoApproveTools.description: Approve every tool Kiro asks to run without asking you first. Leave this off unless you trust the workspace.

kiroChat.reviewFileWrites.description: Open an inline editor review for Kiro's proposed changes, with red/green highlights, per-hunk CodeLens actions, and keyboard shortcuts.

kiroChat.reviewDuringTurn.description: Open each file's review as soon as Kiro finishes editing it, rather than queueing every diff until the end of the turn. Kiro waits for your answer before starting the next edit. Turn this off to review everything together at the end.

kiroChat.command.markdownDescription: Leave empty and the extension will find `kiro-cli` for you. Only set this if it cannot. Run `which kiro-cli` in a terminal to get the full path.

kiroChat.env.description: Extra environment variables for the Kiro process.

kiroChat.instructions.markdownDescription: How you always want Kiro to work — "always reply in Bahasa Malaysia", "use tabs, never spaces". Added to the front of **every** message, so unlike a memory file it is paid for on every turn; keep it short. Edit it from the mode menu under **Your instructions**.

kiroChat.model.description: The model Kiro uses. Leave empty for Kiro's default, which picks one per task. The dropdown in the chat panel sets this for you.

kiroChat.sendSelection.description: Send the code you have highlighted along with your message. The chip above the text box shows what is going; clear the highlight in the editor to leave it out.

scripts.build: npm install && npm run compile && npm run package

virtualWorkspaces.description: Kiro needs real files on disk to work with.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Kiro can read and write files in the folder, so the folder must be trusted.
